transcript.note: Round 1, laid out from the five deg>=3 nodes outward (criterion 1). Frame first: 8 美麗島 (3,4), 16 the yellow crossing (6,4), 4 哈瑪星 (0,4), 3 凹子底 (3,6), 7 凱旋 (4,1) — bearings at all five checked against gx/gy by atan2 before anything else was placed. Then one direction per line (criterion 2): the Orange line is genuinely flat in geography (gy 707-749 across 4/8/16/10/12) so it became row 4 in full — 4(0,4)-8(3,4)-16(6,4)-10(8,4)-12(11,4), four horizontal segments. The Red line is the vertical trunk in column 3: 5(3,8)-3(3,6)-8(3,4), with 9 都會公園 pushed east to (5,8) because its gx 398 is clearly east of 5's 236, giving a horizontal jog 9-5, and 1 岡山 far north at (3,10) so 1-9 runs 45. Vertex 16 became a clean perpendicular crossing: Orange passes through it horizontally, the C ring passes through it vertically 0(6,6)-16(6,4)-14(6,3), because 0/16/14 sit within 32 gx units of each other in reality. The C ring closes as a convex loop 14-7-6-11-4-13-15-3-0-16 with 13/15 stacked in column 1 (gx 53 vs 68) and 11 光榮碼頭 at (2,2) so that both 4-11 and 11-6 come out 45. Column and row orders were assigned strictly from the gx and gy rank orders, so no pair of points had its east/west or north/south relation reversed (criterion 3); the only ties are inside clusters that are already tight in reality (the 208-244 gx band for 1/6/8/5/3, the 707-749 gy band for the Orange line). Left deliberately un-straightened: 8-7 and 7-2, the Red line's southeast run to 小港 — forcing either onto an axis would have had to tie 凱旋 to 美麗島's column or 小港 to 凱旋's row, both of which are visibly wrong on the ground.
